game.name: Football Manager 2007 (Europe)(En,Fr,Es,It)
game.desc: Football Manager 2007 is now available on Xbox 360 for more management, scheming and football coaching. Players have the opportunity to get behind the scenes of their club's management, while being able to rely on the support and advice of their staff. Buy your players, investigate them beforehand, sell them, gain access to international positions and become the best in your field.
